|---------|-----------|-------------|

| **Typical Use‑Case** | Ideal for users who need just the essential functionality without extra bells‑and‑whistles. | Suited for users who want the full feature set (e.g., expanded limits, priority support, additional content) while still staying in a synthetic environment. |
| **Cost** | No real cost (synthetic). | No real cost (synthetic), but conceptually higher‑priced in a real‑world scenario. |
